description:
Aeroplicity is a cloud-based software platform that supports CMMC-related compliance workflows and provides an enclave-oriented environment for handling controlled data, together with enterprise resource planning (ERP), maintenance and repair operations (MRO), governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) workflows, secure collaboration, secure file storage and sharing, document traceability, and operational recordkeeping.
The service supports organizations operating under CMMC, NIST 800-171, DFARS, ITAR, EAR, and related regulatory or contractual requirements by providing compliance workflow management, control evidence collection, audit support, record retention, and traceability for operational and compliance-related activities. Aeroplicity Compliance provides governance, risk, and compliance functions including compliance task management, supporting documentation, control evidence management, and audit-ready records.
Aeroplicity also provides ERP and operational workflow capabilities for procurement, inventory management, logistics, sales order processing, planning, maintenance execution, labor time tracking, training records, and related business processes. The platform supports traceability of documents, parts, materials, and operational activities, including QR code-based workflows connecting physical processes to digital records.
The service includes secure email and messaging, browser-based application access, shared workflow interfaces, file storage and sharing, audit logging, and workflow-based access to operational data across users and teams. Aeroplicity Browser provides browser-based, single-application virtual desktop access to platform functions and data, supporting controlled access workflows in which user interaction occurs within the service environment rather than through local endpoint processing or storage.
Applications and functional components of the service include:
- Aeroplicity Intelligence — AI-assisted analysis and decision-support tools
- Browser — browser-based, single-application virtual desktop access
- Compliance — governance, risk, and compliance workflows, control evidence management, and audit support
- Email — secure email and messaging
- File Share — secure file storage and file sharing
- Interface — shared data access and workflow execution across users and teams
- Inventory — inventory, stock, locations, lot control, and picking workflows
- Logistics — shipping, receiving, and material movement workflows
- Logs — audit logs, record retention, and activity history
- Maintenance — work orders, task cards, and MRO execution
- Marketplace — marketplace workflows
- Planning — demand planning, scheduling, and resource preparation
- Procurement — suppliers, RFQs, and purchase orders
- Sales — quotes, sales orders, and related workflows
- Times — labor time tracking and time recording
- Traceability — digital traceability, document linkage, QR code workflows, and part-level records
- Training — training records, qualifications, tracking, and related workflows

description: Consus Gateway is delivered as a Software as a Service (SaaS) offering using a multi-tenant Government-Only Community Cloud computing environment. It is available to federal contractors and other organizations eligible to consume services hosted in AWS GovCloud (US), GCP Assured Workloads, and Azure Government. The CSO is an OpenAI-compatible AI model routing service: customer applications submit requests to a single API endpoint, and the gateway routes each request to the appropriate large-language-model (LLM) provider hosted within a FedRAMP-authorized cloud environment (AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, or Azure OpenAI Service). The system is designed with a zero-persistence architecture: prompt and response content are processed entirely in ephemeral AWS Lambda memory and are never written to disk, logged, or stored in any persistent data store. The only persistent records are operational metadata (request identifier, API key identifier, timestamp, model name, token counts, latency, source IP) used for billing, accountability, and continuous monitoring. The intended user base is United States federal agencies and US-person contractor organizations supporting federal missions.

description:
Genesys Cloud™ is an AI-powered experience orchestration platform with a full suite of omnichannel contact center capabilities, built-in workforce engagement management (WEM) and artificial intelligence (AI). It is available to the public, federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions, federal contractors and government contractors. 

Features and capabilities include: 

All-in-One open platform - Genesys Cloud is a multi-tenant SaaS offering with a comprehensive set of native Contact Center-as-a-Service (CCaaS) product capabilities built on a single platform — running on Amazon Web Services (AWS). 

Native AI - Genesys Cloud has built-in conversational and predictive AI capabilities. It utilizes technologies such as predictive analytics, machine learning, and natural language understanding to automate, route and personalize interactions.

 Omnichannel routing - Genesys Cloud supports calls, email, web, text and social messages. A single routing engine leverages a variety of routing algorithms, evaluation and scoring methods to determine the next best action while maintaining context, intent, and desired outcome.

 Speech-enabled IVR & self-service – Genesys Cloud offers multilingual speech-enabled IVR with natural language understanding (NLU) technology.  Automated bot assistants provide continuous support for routine queries.

 Workforce Engagement Management - A native suite of AI-powered WEM capabilities supports employee onboarding and includes workforce schedule management (WFM), coaching, speech & text analytics, quality management, performance management and gamification.

 Outbound campaigns – Genesys Cloud supports outbound dialing and digital campaigns for sending proactive notifications or contacting contact lists of people in accordance with programmable rules.

 Analytics and reporting – Genesys Cloud provides real-time dashboards and analytics for contact center management, with customizable reporting and drill-down capabilities for performance analysis.

Integrations - The platform includes a rich set of open APIs, integration methods and an ecosystem of 600+ pre-built solutions and applications available via the AppFoundry® Marketplace.

description:
Gobo provides an intuitive, AI-enabled cognitive automation platform designed to analyze complex datasets, apply intelligent operational logic, and streamline workflows across enterprise IT infrastructure, services, and business processes. The Gobo platform is built to bring actionable intelligence to light, prioritizing simplicity of use, speed of results, and quality of outcomes. Through secure, web-based applications called I2Apps, Gobo automates routine engineering and operations tasks while maintaining strict human-in-the-loop control, auditability, and governance. As a vendor-agnostic platform, Gobo integrates seamlessly with existing systems and data environments, empowering federal agencies to modernize their operations while avoiding costly vendor lock-in.

To support diverse agency missions, Gobo delivers core capabilities across three key operational areas:
AI-Enabled Cognitive Automation: Gobo applies semantic intelligence to help agencies empower personnel to automate complex, data-intensive tasks at scale. As a prime example of this capability, Gobo modernizes public comment analysis and regulatory review management. Alongside this, Gobo features intelligent agents to orchestrate complex administrative and technical processes with speed, precision, and reliable predictability.
Infrastructure Digital Twin (IDT) and Performance Management: Leveraging Gobo's IDT capabilities, the platform provides deep, continuous visibility to enable secure, unified, and adaptive IT ecosystems. Gobo streamlines complex migrations with Service Transition Management, facilitating structured transition planning and tracking for critical federal mandates such as the IPv6 transition. This is supported by automated Configuration Management, and Capacity Planning, alongside real-time performance tracking to optimize network operations and ensure system availability.
Enterprise Infrastructure Solutions (EIS) Support: To automate administrative oversight, Gobo streamlines GSA EIS service management, allowing agencies to monitor how well telecommunications service providers meet promised service levels. The platform provides precision Contract Line Item Number (CLIN) and Invoice Management to track line items, automate invoice reconciliation, and facilitate dispute resolution. This capability operates alongside continuous SLA and Service Inventory Management to track the full lifecycle of agency IT assets and recover service provider credits.
